players.name: Zaire Franklin
players.comment: Franklin (shin) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

players.name: Ty'Ron Hopper
players.comment: Hopper (illness) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Evan Williams
players.comment: Williams logged five tackles (four solo) and one interception during the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.

players.name: Xavier McKinney
players.comment: McKinney (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

players.name: Javon Bullard
players.comment: Bullard (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

players.name: Trey Smack
players.comment: Smack (calf) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Savion Williams
players.comment: Williams (groin) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Vikings, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Eric Wilson
players.comment: Wilson recorded nine tackles (three solo) in Monday night's 23-6 loss to the Bills.

players.name: Joshua Metellus
players.comment: Metellus (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Packers.

players.name: Will Reichard
players.comment: Reichard made both of his field-goal attempts during the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.comment: Jefferson stands to benefit from Tuesday's acquisition of Kirk Cousins, who is expected to take over as the Vikings' starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game against the Packers, Michael F. Florio of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.comment: Addison (thumb) is inactive for Sunday's game at Green Bay, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.comment: The Vikings have already gauged Cousins' interest in returning to the team in 2027 since acquiring him Tuesday in a trade with the Raiders, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.comment: Mason rushed six times for 35 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night.
